[project]
name = "dokumentenpruefung"
version = "1.0.0"
description = "Vollständigkeitsprüfung Modul der Dokumentprüfung Komponente im KI System"
dependencies = [
    "apscheduler>=3.10.1",
    "asyncpg>=0.30.0",
    "bizlog",
    "bmds-ki-logging",
    "bmds-ki-validierung",
    "bmds-prompt-security",
    "boto3>=1.40.52",
    "botocore>=1.40.52",
    "duckdb>=0.10.0",
    "duckdb-engine>=0.17.0",
    "fastapi>=0.100.0",
    "faiss-cpu>=1.7.4",
    "langsmith>=0.9.1",
    "numpy>=1.21.0",
    "openpyxl>=3.1.5",
    "xlrd>=2.0.1",
    "opentelemetry-sdk>=1.34.0",
    "puremagic>=1.28",
    "opentelemetry-instrumentation-fastapi>=0.50b0",
    "opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http>=1.34.0",
    "pandas>=2.3.2",
    "pika>=1.3.2",
    "prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator>=7.1.0",
    "psycopg>=3.2.10",
    "psycopg-binary>=3.2.10",
    "pydantic>=2.0.0",
    "pydantic-settings>=2.14.2",
    "pypdf>=6.14.2",
    "pytest-cov>=6.3.0",
    "python-multipart>=0.0.32",
    "pyyaml>=6.0.0",
    "requests>=2.33.0",
    "uvicorn>=0.20.0",
    "urllib3>=2.7.0",
    "starlette>=1.3.1",
    "pygments>=2.20.0",
    "python-dotenv>=1.2.2",
    "cryptography>=50.0.0",
    "mistralai>=2.0.0",
    "filelock>=3.20.3",
    "httpx>=0.28.1",
    "tenacity>=9.0.0",
    "scikit-learn>=1.5.2",
    "hdbscan>=0.8.41",
    "rapidfuzz>=3.9",
    "pkg-decision-protocol",
    "bmds-prompt-loader",
]
requires-python = ">=3.12,<3.13"

[project.scripts]
dokumentenpruefung = "dokumentenpruefung:main.main"
export-openapi-json = "dokumentenpruefung.scripts:export_openapi.export_openapi_json"
